candidates.violated_requirement: The Gray-to-binary conversion should correctly decode the MSB. Changing the MSB conversion will cause incorrect binary values and thus incorrect Gray code outputs.
candidates.spec_basis: Gray code to binary conversion step must accurately decode each bit position

candidates.violated_requirement: The LSB Gray-to-binary conversion should use XOR. Using OR will produce incorrect binary values affecting the entire counter sequence.
candidates.spec_basis: Gray code to binary conversion requires XOR operations between adjacent bits
